question: What types of software does Techxtrasol build?
answer: We build custom websites, web applications, mobile apps, enterprise software, SaaS platforms, APIs, system integrations, HR systems, POS systems, finance and accounting systems, document management systems, custom dashboards, and cloud solutions. If it involves software, we can build it.

question: How long does a typical project take?
answer: Project timelines vary depending on complexity. A standard business website takes 3 to 6 weeks. A web application or mobile app typically takes 8 to 16 weeks. Enterprise systems and SaaS platforms can take 3 to 6 months. We provide a detailed timeline during the discovery phase so you know exactly what to expect.

question: Do you work with startups or only established businesses?
answer: We work with both. Startups benefit from our lean development approach and MVP-focused strategy. Established businesses trust us to modernize their systems and build scalable solutions that grow with them. Our clients range from NGOs and schools to fintech companies and e-commerce platforms.

question: What technologies does Techxtrasol use?
answer: We use modern, proven technologies including Laravel, Nuxt.js, Vue.js, Go, Node.js, React, Flutter, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, Docker, and major cloud platforms. We choose the right stack for each project based on performance requirements, scalability needs, and long-term maintainability.

question: Do you provide ongoing support after launch?
answer: Yes. We offer maintenance and support plans that include bug fixes, security updates, performance monitoring, and feature enhancements. We believe in long-term partnerships, not one-off projects. Many of our clients have been with us for years.

question: How do you ensure the security of the software you build?
answer: Security is built into every stage of our development process. We follow OWASP best practices, implement encryption at rest and in transit, conduct regular security audits, and perform penetration testing before deployment. We also set up monitoring and alerting to catch issues early.

question: Can you work with our existing systems?
answer: Absolutely. We specialize in system integrations and can connect your new software with existing tools, databases, and third-party services. Whether you need API integrations, data migration, or a layer that unifies multiple systems, we have the experience to make it seamless.

question: How much does a custom software project cost?
answer: Every project is unique, so we provide custom quotes after an initial discovery session. Factors that influence cost include project complexity, number of features, integrations required, and timeline. We always provide transparent pricing with no hidden fees, and we can work within most budgets to deliver maximum value.
